full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio portrait shows a woman from the upper chest upward against an almost entirely black background. Her head tilts back and slightly to the left, lifting the chin into a strong beam of light. Dense dark curly hair fills the upper and left edges, with loose ringlets dissolving into the shadow. Thin-framed round sunglasses cover both eyes; the lenses are very dark but retain a muted gray reflection. A fine straight temple line crosses the right side of the face toward the ear. The nose and full closed lips are modeled with silvery highlights and deep adjacent shadow. One small bright earring and a narrow dangling hoop catch light at the right ear. A dark ruffled lace choker wraps the neck. The shoulder at lower right is bare and pale, while dark clothing or deep shadow swallows the lower left. The light enters from upper left and slightly in front, creating a bright diagonal across the nose, lips, chin, cheek, and shoulder. It leaves the far side of the hair and the space behind her nearly black. Skin tones range through smooth pearl gray and charcoal, but fine grain remains visible in the photograph. A hard shadow line from the glasses and hair breaks the lit face into angular zones. The background contains no furniture, text, or other setting detail. The crop is intimate and the viewpoint is slightly low, giving the tilted pose a deliberate fashion-photography confidence. Dark circles of the lenses, irregular curls, and the bright arc of the jaw create a compact rhythm in the upper half. The frame depends on a few strongly lit planes held inside generous black negative space, making the portrait dramatic without adding decorative surroundings.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形黑白影棚肖像描绘一名女子胸口以上的形象，背景几乎全黑。她把头向后并略向左倾，下巴抬入一道强光。浓密深色卷发填满上方与左边，松散卷缕消入阴影。细框圆墨镜遮住双眼；镜片很暗，但仍有低调灰色反光。一条细直镜腿横过面部右侧，通向耳朵。鼻子和丰满闭合的嘴唇由银亮高光与相邻深影塑造。右耳一枚小亮耳饰和细长垂环接住光。深色皱边蕾丝颈饰围住脖子。右下肩膀裸露而浅亮，深色衣服或浓影吞掉左下。光从左上及稍前方进入，在鼻、唇、下巴、颊与肩上形成亮斜线。远侧头发和身后空间则几乎全黑。肤色从平滑珍珠灰过渡到炭灰，照片里仍有细颗粒。墨镜与头发造成的硬影界把受光面部分成棱角区域。背景没有家具、文字或其他场景细节。裁切亲密，视点略低，让扬头姿势有刻意的时尚摄影自信。镜片的暗圆、散乱卷发与下颌亮弧在上半幅形成紧凑节奏。画面依靠少数强光平面留在宽阔黑色负空间里，没有装饰环境也很有戏剧性。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white studio photography concentrates a hard directional beam on a small cluster of curved planes while most of the frame stays deep black. Silvery highlights and charcoal midtones model smooth volume, interrupted by crisp shadow cuts and tiny reflective glints. Dense irregular dark texture gathers near the top and edges, then dissolves into the unlit ground. Circular shapes, fine lines, and one bright sweeping contour make a compact focal rhythm. Subtle photographic grain prevents the high contrast from becoming flat graphic fill. Tight cropping and a slightly low viewpoint add visual force, while broad negative space lets the illuminated area breathe. The result is dramatic, tactile, and controlled through value rather than color.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白影棚摄影把坚决的定向光束集中在一小簇弯曲平面上，画幅大部留在深黑。银亮高光与炭灰中间调塑造平滑体积，清楚影界和细小反光点从中切过。浓密不规则暗肌理聚在顶部与边缘，随后溶入未照亮底色。圆形、细线与一道明亮弧线组成紧凑焦点节奏。细微摄影颗粒避免高反差成为平面图形填色。紧贴裁切与稍低视点增强视觉力度，宽阔负空间则让受光区域有呼吸余地。最终画面戏剧性强、可触且受控，以明度而非色彩成形。
theme_en: A woman in dark sunglasses lit by a narrow dramatic studio beam
theme_zh: 一名戴深色墨镜的女子受到狭窄戏剧性影棚光照亮
name: Portrait shot with contrasty lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
